_readme: Not loaded by Claude Code. Reference only: the ~/.claude/settings.json fragments needed on a machine after pulling this repo, so the hooks in hooks/ actually run, plus a permissions.deny defense-in-depth rule for secret files. settings.json itself is user-level config and is not tracked in this repo. Merge these into your own settings.json (keep whatever else is already there) rather than overwriting the whole file. Note: claude-resume-on-precompact.ps1 is an extra hook that runs on this machine, but it belongs to a separate 'Claude Notifier' VSCode extension, not this repo -- it is not covered here and does not sync via git pull.
_steps: 1. git pull (or clone) this repo into ~/.claude/skills.

2. Copy hooks/{ask-on-git-push,changelog-on-commit,pre-commit-check-on-commit,destructive-guard,gitleaks-guard,cache-guard,claude-resume-on-sessionstart,sven-gatekeeper,sven-telegram-notify,sven-ask,handover}.js from ~/.claude/skills/hooks/ into ~/.claude/hooks/ (the active, non-tracked location).

3. On Windows, use the literal absolute path in each command string (e.g. C:\\Users\\<you>\\.claude\\hooks\\destructive-guard.js); $HOME is written here so the quoted path expands in a POSIX shell (a quoted ~ does not).

4. Merge permissions.deny, permissions.ask (append any entries you don't already have), and hooks.PreToolUse's 'Bash|PowerShell' matcher (add the command entries you don't already have, keep any matcher/notifier entries already in your settings.json) into your settings.json by hand, or paste your current settings.json to Claude Code and ask it to merge this file in. permissions.deny blocks Read/Edit/Write on .env* and .credentials.json anywhere on the filesystem (the Bash tool is not covered -- Bash deny rules are prefix-matched text, not a real security boundary, per Claude Code's own docs); it cannot be overridden by allow/ask or defaultMode.
5. Install gitleaks (e.g. `winget install --id Gitleaks.Gitleaks` on Windows) so gitleaks-guard.js actually scans instead of failing open.
